desc: Implement the full solution in Python as described in NEXT, ensuring O(sum N) time and passing sample tests.
Analyze operation invariants: order preserved, gaps never increase, reachable final gap vectors satisfy h_j ≤ g_j.
Reduce problem to choosing split points S_j for blocks assigned to B positions with g_{S_j} ≥ b_{j+1}-b_j, and cost = max(R-D+B, A+D).
Derive LB = max(b_1 - p_1, p_K - b_M) and prove answer is either LB or LB+1.
Handle edge cases: K < M, single piece, all pieces already matching B, large T with small N, negative D, and fast I/O.
